done_when: The shared test setup sets the coordinator route and the other environment defaults explicitly, and a test that needs a different route says so

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional — The shared fixture deletes FORGE_LIVE_CODEX during the outer test. tests/test_fix_codex_test_home.py:64–69 then launches a nested pytest with a copy of that environment and requires `1 passed`. The nested smoke test checks FORGE_LIVE_CODEX at collection and is skipped, so the configured codex-smoke job fails when it runs with credentials.
findings.title: The live Codex smoke test loses its opt-in in a nested pytest run

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 3, Harm 1
Raise: Test — The proof list describes a run with leaked FORGE_CHECKS_WAIT, FORGE_LAND_ROUNDS and AUTOREVIEW, but no test in the suite injects those values or a different coordinator route before exercising this fixture. The named land test receives them only when its caller happens to supply them. A normal clean run would therefore still pass if this isolation were removed. The existing nested-environment test covers GIT_ variables only.
findings.title: Not done: a suite regression test for inherited coordinator and Forge defaults

why: Tests pick up the session's coordinator route and other defaults without saying so, so one default change broke 73 tests
